image_description: A rooster (cock) standing on a concrete surface with dappled sunlight. The bird has black body plumage with iridescent green/blue sheen, golden-orange hackle feathers on the neck, and a bright red comb and wattles. To the right, there is a paint can and a circular lid on the ground. The lighting creates high-contrast shadows.
